title: Huntington Floodwall Pump Station Automation
overview: Automation upgrades for the seventeen floodwall pump stations protecting Huntington. Cellular SCADA units monitor the large storm-water and sewage pumps, their belt-oiler systems, and run time, and replace the old mercury floats with transducer-based level sensing. Each station gets a new electrical service with a service-rated manual transfer switch so staff can connect a portable generator to keep monitoring online.
